name: Climb Central Bangkok
research_notes: The official site climbcentral.co.th was unreachable from this network (TLS and connection errors), and the Facebook bio shows only an air-conditioned sport climbing facility. Directories mention a bouldering cave, but no primary source was readable, so bouldering stays unknown. Types are the rope offer only; hours and open status were not confirmed from a primary page.

research_notes: Thai branch of the Singapore Boulder Planet brand, inside Future Park Rangsit. Coordinates are the pin of the "find us" map link on the official home page.

name: REBEL Rock Climbing
research_notes: Official site lists five boulder sectors with 40+ problems, a Kilter board, and rope walls; open Tuesday to Sunday, closed Monday. The gap-analysis lead doubted bouldering, but the official site confirms it.
